thread:
anya: Quick sync  we need a compact invite + acceptance flow for the next DP wave. Target 8 partners, 6 weeks, mix hosted + private. Keep gates strict but onboarding fast.

ricardo: Proposal: two tracks - "lite-hosted" (lighter gates) and "private-eval" (strict). Auto-score intake, manual review for borderline cases.

meenal: For intake scoring: weight product intent (30%), integration owner present (20%), infra risk (20%), business impact (20%), timeline (10%). Auto-accept >=70%.

cody: Ops note: private capacity = 3 concurrent full-evals. Reserve 1 emergency hotfix slot/week. Recommend waves of 3 with a 10-14 day stagger.

anya: Hard gates for private: signed DPA, on-prem checklist, named compliance contact. For hosted: telemetry enabled + perf baseline.

ricardo: Perf bars suggestion: hosted p95 < 380ms, private p95 < 520ms (allow variance). Also track token-cost delta; if >2x, add a cost review step.

meenal: Correctness checks: each partner provides 10 deterministic prompts; we run them weekly and compute pass rate. If drift >6% for 2 weeks we open an eval incident and rollback to fallback.

cody: Add a practical exclusion list in the invite: no heavy streaming, no large backfill jobs. Allow small streaming samples only.

anya: Incentives: credits + 3 solutions hours for first 3 private partners + priority triage. Solutions confirmed grants available.

ricardo: Stop/pause criteria: pause invites if >40% partners hit blocker status for >72h or private infra utilization >80% for >5 days.

meenal: Feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync + async 6-question pulse after integration and at week6 + automated eval dashboard. Capture acceptance owner on intake to avoid stalls.

intake-bot: Intake form: https://redwood.internal/dp/wave-intake. Will auto-score and tag legal-block if flagged.

anya: Action items: anya publish invite copy (EOD), ricardo reserve ops slots + wave calendar (Tue), meenal add eval harness + prompts (Tue), cody confirm hotfix reservations (Tue). I'll post final invite once done. Thanks. :rocket:
